component.id: (select top 1 case when count(distinct nullif(aamamouNo, '')) > 1 then 'multi mou' when (aammouNo is null or aammouNo = '') then '-' else aammouNo end from dboagrmntAssetMappingAms aama with (nolock) where aamaassetNo = aassetNo)SearchId
component.label: Cwr No
component.name: (SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(aama.MOU_NO, '')) > 1 THEN 'Multi MOU' WHEN (AAM.MOU_NO IS NULL OR AAM.MOU_NO = '') THEN '-' ELSE AAM.MOU_NO END FROM dbo.AGRMNT_ASSET_MAPPING_AMS aama WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE aama.ASSET_NO = A.ASSET_NO)

component.id: (select top 1 case when count(distinct aamaagrmntNo) > 1 then 'multi agreement' else case when (aamaagrmntNo is null or aamaagrmntNo = '') then '-' else aamaagrmntNo end end from dboagrmntAssetMappingAms aama with (nolock) where aamaassetNo = aassetNo group by aamaagrmntNo)SearchId
component.label: Agreement No
component.name: (SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT aama.AGRMNT_NO) > 1 THEN 'Multi Agreement' ELSE CASE WHEN (aama.AGRMNT_NO IS NULL OR aama.AGRMNT_NO = '') THEN '-' ELSE aama.AGRMNT_NO END END FROM dbo.AGRMNT_ASSET_MAPPING_AMS aama WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE aama.ASSET_NO = A.ASSET_NO GROUP BY aama.AGRMNT_NO)

component.id: (select top 1 case when count(distinct aamacustNo) > 1 then 'multi customer' else case when cacustName is null or cacustName = '' then '-' else cacustName end end as custname from dboagrmntAssetMappingAms aama with (nolock) where aamaassetNo = aassetNo)SearchId
component.label: Customer / Debitur Name
component.name: (SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT AAMA.CUST_NO) > 1 THEN 'Multi Customer' ELSE CASE WHEN CA.CUST_NAME IS NULL OR CA.CUST_NAME = '' THEN '-' ELSE CA.CUST_NAME END END AS CustName FROM dbo.AGRMNT_ASSET_MAPPING_AMS AAMA WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE AAMA.ASSET_NO = A.ASSET_NO)

component.id: case when aditrDestOfficeCode is not null then aditrDestOfficeCode else case when adbrcLocationOfficeCode is not null and aditrDestOfficeCode is null then adbrcLocationOfficeCode else aoinventoryOfficeCode end endSearchId
component.label: Office Name
component.name: CASE WHEN AD.ITR_DEST_OFFICE_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN AD.ITR_DEST_OFFICE_CODE ELSE CASE WHEN AD.BRC_LOCATION_OFFICE_CODE IS NOT NULL AND AD.ITR_DEST_OFFICE_CODE IS NULL THEN AD.BRC_LOCATION_OFFICE_CODE ELSE AO.INVENTORY_OFFICE_CODE END END

component.id: case when addocStatCode = 'wtg' then case when adexpectedRcvDt <= vsccsysValue then 'nd' else 'od' end else case when adexpectedReturnDt is null or adexpectedReturnDt <= vsccsysValue then 'nd' else 'od' end endSearchId
component.label: Document Due Status
component.name: CASE WHEN AD.DOC_STAT_CODE = 'WTG' THEN CASE WHEN AD.EXPECTED_RCV_DT <= VSCC.SYS_VALUE THEN 'ND' ELSE 'OD' END ELSE CASE WHEN AD.EXPECTED_RETURN_DT IS NULL OR AD.EXPECTED_RETURN_DT <= VSCC.SYS_VALUE THEN 'ND' ELSE 'OD' END END

headerList.label: Agreement No
headerList.name: (SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT aama.AGRMNT_NO) > 1 THEN 'Multi Agreement' ELSE CASE WHEN (aama.AGRMNT_NO IS NULL OR aama.AGRMNT_NO = '') THEN '-' ELSE aama.AGRMNT_NO END END FROM dbo.AGRMNT_ASSET_MAPPING_AMS aama WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE aama.ASSET_NO = A.ASSET_NO GROUP BY aama.AGRMNT_NO)

headerList.label: Customer / Debitur Name
headerList.name: (SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT AAMA.CUST_NO) > 1 THEN 'Multi Customer' ELSE CASE WHEN CA.CUST_NAME IS NULL OR CA.CUST_NAME = '' THEN '-' ELSE CA.CUST_NAME END END AS CustName FROM dbo.AGRMNT_ASSET_MAPPING_AMS AAMA WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE AAMA.ASSET_NO = A.ASSET_NO)
